50106.title: Course logistics and Ed etiquette
50106.document:
Read this before posting.

Search before you ask, never post solution code publicly, and use private threads for questions about your own code.

Staff aim to answer within 24 hours on weekdays. LaIR runs Sunday to Thursday, 7 to 11 PM.

50103.title: Problem Set 5 FAQ
50103._detail_document:
Q: Can we cite lecture results without proof?
A: Yes, cite the lecture and theorem number.

Q: Do we need to prove the base case of an induction separately?
A: Always.
